description: Explicit, behavior-verified disposition of the vendored Hermes tui_gateway WebSocket JSON-RPC dialect. Qubit runs ONE event path (SSE + REST) and ONE session/broker authority on the single listener. The upstream /api/ws dialect is a sidecar that drives the tui_gateway agent process and binds a SECOND session id ('both transports bind to the same session id'); serving it would add a second chat/event authority alongside Qubit's broker. It is therefore a typed SAFE_EQUIVALENT refusal whose counterpart is exercised by tests/test_ws_dialect_disposition.py. The WS ticket mint (/api/auth/ws-ticket) is genuinely implemented on the single listener (scoped, single-use tickets).
listener: the existing ThreadingHTTPServer (voicebridge/webui.py); no second listener, port, or authority

owner_approval.authority: Owner directive (2026-09-19): either implement the required /api/ws behavior through the single Qubit listener or record an explicit owner-approved typed safe equivalent with evidence. Implementing the tui_gateway dialect would add the second session/event authority the guardrails forbid, so the owner approved the typed SAFE_EQUIVALENT refusal below.
owner_approval.approved_scope: GET /api/ws tui_gateway JSON-RPC dialect on the single Qubit listener
owner_approval.counterpart_proof: GET /api/events (SSE) + POST /api/qubit/chat + POST /api/qubit/chat/stream; POST /api/auth/ws-ticket (scope pty|rpc, single-use)
owner_approval.refusal_surface: HTTP 426 Upgrade Required (WebSocket upgrade) / HTTP 403 (plain) with the JSON code WS_SINGLE_PATH; never a bare close or 404 on the SPA path /agent/api/ws
evidence: voicebridge/hermes_compat.py GATED entry for GET /api/ws (code WS_SINGLE_PATH)

surfaces.rationale: Upstream /api/ws drives the tui_gateway sidecar and binds its own session id; Qubit keeps one broker/session/event path. The counterpart is proven reachable on the same listener.

surfaces.qubit_counterpart: POST /api/auth/ws-ticket with scope=pty|rpc mints Qubit's own short-lived single-use ticket
surfaces.rationale: Qubit serves the WS ticket handshake on the single listener; the vendor dialect ticket is not needed.

surfaces.evidence: voicebridge/hermes_compat.py GATED pattern /api/ws (the SPA /agent prefix is stripped before dispatch, so /agent/api/ws maps to the same gate)
surfaces.rationale: The SPA reaches the same single event path through the /agent prefix; the tui_gateway method registry is not mounted as a second authority.
